headline: French Lunch Core 30
threshold: Order, discuss and resolve a full lunch in French with English support.

lessons.title: Choose a Neighborhood Lunch Place
lessons.objective: Ask a local where they eat, compare wait times and seating, and decide whether a nearby place feels aimed at visitors.
lessons.focus: Use où vous déjeunez, il faut attendre, il reste des places, and c’est surtout pour les touristes in a short recommendation exchange.
lessons.scene: At a market square, Maya asks a local which nearby place they genuinely choose.
